# Non-Functional & State-Integrity Requirements Quality Checklist: 1024 Browser Game

**Purpose**: Validate that the measurable-quality requirements (performance, accessibility, themes, offline, privacy) and the state-integrity requirements (undo, persistence, concurrent tabs, win/game-over) are complete, unambiguous, consistent, and objectively verifiable before the open release gates are signed off
**Created**: 2026-10-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Scope decisions** (defaults applied because no inline arguments were given and the session was non-interactive): depth Standard; audience Reviewer (PR / release-gate sign-off); focus the two clusters with the most open risk, namely (1) non-functional measurability, which maps to the unchecked gates in [verification.md](../verification.md), and (2) state integrity across undo, persistence, and multiple tabs. Core slide/merge rules (FR-001 to FR-009) are excluded: they are already precise and covered by the test-first principle.

## Performance & Delivery Measurability

- [ ] CHK001 Is "current mid-range phones" defined with a reference device class or benchmark, so FR-036, FR-056, and SC-009 can be judged objectively? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-056, §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "a fast 4G connection" defined with throughput and latency figures? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-057, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "first load complete" tied to a specific moment (interactive, last asset transferred, or a named paint metric), and is cold versus warm cache stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-057]
- [ ] CHK004 Does "total transfer size" state whether it is compressed or uncompressed, and whether service-worker precache traffic and manifest icons count toward the 300 KB budget? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-058, §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Are FR-036/SC-009 (150 ms animations) and FR-056 (60 fps) stated once, or duplicated across FR and SC with room for drift? [Consistency, Spec §FR-036, §FR-056, §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the "standard web quality assessments" named, and is the mapping of "search visibility" to a specific scored category stated? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-059]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the 90-point thresholds scoped to a device profile and throttling mode, given scores vary by profile? [Gap, Spec §FR-059]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the "latest two stable versions" browser baseline anchored to a date or release, so SC-011 does not change meaning over time? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-011]

## Accessibility Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK009 Is "must-have requirement" defined within the spec, given FR-055 depends on a priority label that the spec does not assign to any requirement? [Gap, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK010 Does FR-054 distinguish text-only enlargement to 200% from page zoom to 200% (reflow), and which one governs the "200% text" edge case? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-054, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the content, timing, and verbosity of screen-reader announcements specified (every move, only score deltas, politeness level)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-051]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the cell reading requirement state whether position (row/column) is announced along with "tile value or empty"? [Gap, Spec §FR-052]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the dialogs enumerated (win, game over, new-game confirmation, help, settings) with required dismissal behavior (Escape, focus containment, background inertness) for each? [Gap, Spec §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK014 Is keyboard behavior defined for arrow keys when focus is on a control or inside a dialog, including preventing page scroll? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, §FR-047]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the interaction between the game-over dialog and the undo action (FR-028) specified, i.e. whether undo is reachable while the dialog is open? [Conflict, Spec §FR-023, §FR-028, §US2-2]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the 24 by 24 CSS pixel requirement state which elements it applies to and how it relates to the 44-pixel guidance players on phones typically need? [Clarity, Spec §FR-053]
- [ ] CHK017 Can SC-004's "zero violations" be objectively verified, given the scanning tool and ruleset are unnamed and the plan treats the scan as a manual gate? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK018 Is contrast for tile values on every tile color (including values above 1024) specified per theme, not only at the theme level? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024, §FR-045, §FR-049]

## Themes & Motion

- [ ] CHK019 Is the behavior defined when the operating-system light/dark preference changes after the first visit and no manual choice exists? [Gap, Spec §FR-042]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for how the high-contrast theme relates to operating-system contrast or forced-colors preferences? [Gap, Spec §FR-044]
- [ ] CHK021 Is "distinguishable under a common red-green color vision deficiency simulation" quantified, with the deficiency types and a pass criterion named? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-044, §SC-016]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the theme selection control specified (how four themes are chosen, and which is shown as active)? [Gap, Spec §FR-041, §FR-043, §FR-044]
- [ ] CHK023 Does FR-037's "removed or reduced to a simple fade" fix a single behavior, or leave two outcomes that testers could judge differently? Is the score-gain indicator (FR-018) addressed under reduced motion? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-018, §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK024 Is "brief" quantified for the score-gain indicator duration? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-018]

## Offline, Sound & Privacy

- [ ] CHK025 Do FR-040 (audio fetched only when sound is first enabled) and FR-060/SC-006 (full offline once installed) conflict for a player who installs, goes offline, and then enables sound for the first time? [Conflict, Spec §FR-040, §FR-060, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Does the edge case "sound files ship with the game rather than being fetched from a server" contradict FR-040/SC-015's "never downloads any audio"? [Conflict, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-040, §SC-015]
- [ ] CHK027 Is "first enables sound" defined for returning visits where the stored setting is already on? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-040]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the update behavior in FR-061 specified for the cases where a new version changes the stored-game format, given the edge case says an incompatible stored game "starts cleanly"? [Conflict, Spec §FR-061, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the scope of "personal data" in FR-062 defined, so that storing the game and best score is clearly permitted? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-062]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for storage that works at read time but fails on write (quota, revoked permission) partway through a session? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §US3-5]

## Undo, Win & Game-Over State Integrity

- [ ] CHK031 Do US1-5 ("the game ends when the player attempts any move") and FR-022 ("the game MUST end when the board is full and no two neighbours match") agree on when game over is detected? [Conflict, Spec §US1-5, §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK032 Is behavior specified for undoing the move that created the first 1024 tile, including whether the win message may appear again when 1024 is re-created? [Gap, Spec §FR-019, §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK033 Does the edge case "including the win state if that was what ended it" reconcile with FR-019/FR-021, where reaching 1024 does not end the game? [Ambiguity, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the effect of choosing "keep playing" on undo defined (can the player undo across that choice)? [Gap, Spec §FR-021, §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK035 Is it stated whether the undo snapshot itself is persisted, or only an "undo available" flag, given FR-031 says "undo state" and SC-010 says "undo availability"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-031, §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK036 Does the "best score returns to its previous value" requirement state how it interacts with a best score already persisted to the device when the move was made? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, §FR-026, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK037 Is "a game in progress" defined for FR-030's confirmation (does it apply to a game with zero moves, or a finished game)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK038 Does SC-010's 24-hour window conflict with FR-032's unbounded "resume exactly where it left off"? [Conflict, Spec §FR-032, §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK039 Is it specified whether the best score is retained when the stored game is unreadable or from an incompatible version? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK040 Is "the number of moves made" (Key Entities) consumed by any requirement, or should it be removed/justified? [Traceability, Spec Key Entities]

## Concurrent Tabs & Input Handling

- [ ] CHK041 Does FR-034 define what the stale tab does after showing the notice (auto-refresh to the newer save, require dismissal, or accept further moves that overwrite)? [Gap, Spec §FR-034, §SC-013]
- [ ] CHK042 Are settings changes (theme, sound) in one tab addressed for other open tabs? [Gap, Spec §FR-033, §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK043 Is FR-064's "handled consistently" resolved to a single policy (queue or ignore), or does the choice remain open to implementers? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-064]
- [ ] CHK044 Are multi-touch and cancelled-gesture cases (pinch, second finger, system interruption) addressed for FR-012/FR-013? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK045 Is a viewport height constraint defined for landscape phones, given FR-065 specifies only width (320 px up) and FR-066 requires a square board? [Gap, Spec §FR-065, §FR-066]
- [ ] CHK046 Is "large desktop monitor" given an upper bound? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-065, §SC-007]

## Success Criteria Quality & Traceability

- [ ] CHK047 Can SC-001 (95% of first-time players) and SC-012 (4 of 5 testers) be satisfied at the stated sample size of five, and is the sample size for SC-001 specified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-012]
- [ ] CHK048 Are "polished, responsive, and worth returning to" defined with an observable rubric? [Measurability, Spec §SC-012]
- [ ] CHK049 Does SC-003 ("every rule listed in the Functional Requirements is covered by an automated check") conflict with the manual-only status of accessibility, performance, and device checks? [Conflict, Spec §SC-003, §SC-004, §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK050 Is the stated intent of SC-002 (50 moves in under three minutes with a correct board) tied to a verifiable procedure and a defined pass condition? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK051 Does the spec cite BRD requirement IDs for each FR, as the constitution's workflow requires, or is traceability left to the coverage note in `requirements.md`? [Traceability, Gap, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK052 Is the precedence rule "the BRD wins" in Assumptions usable, given the BRD is not referenced by a stable path or version? [Traceability, Assumption, Spec Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Items tagged `[Conflict]` are candidates for `/speckit-clarify`; CHK025/CHK026, CHK031, CHK038, and CHK049 are the highest-impact ones
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
